name: S1Client::evict_models

test_list.description: The client completes the S1 handshake, authenticates EvictModels, and returns the worker's model-drop acknowledgement count.
A response claiming more than one evicted model is rejected as a protocol failure because the S1 worker has one native engine.
The EvictModels RPC is bounded by the client's configured timeout.
Worker unavailability maps to DecisionError::Unavailable and other RPC failures map to DecisionError::Model.
The authenticated worker rejects EvictModels when the client does not present the expected worker credential.

inputs.name: self
inputs.description: Authenticated client configured for one local S1 worker endpoint.

output_description: The worker's serialized model-drop acknowledgement count, limited to zero or one; this does not pause heavy-build admission, preempt active work, or prove an RSS reduction.
